description: The plot illustrates the performance of different model variants on the HateXplain dataset, comparing their metric values. The x-axis is labeled "Model Variants" and lists five categories: "Full model (Ours)", "w/o Prompt", "w/o Augmentation", "w/o Attention", and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation", with a categorical scale. The y-axis is labeled "Metric (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 58 to 66, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The plot displays three lines: a purple line representing an unspecified metric, a blue line for "Recall", and a brown line for "F1-score", all with circle markers and solid line styles. The purple line starts at 65.56 for "Full model (Ours)" and ends at 65.44 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation", with values decreasing to 61.06 for "w/o Prompt", then increasing to 63.7 for "w/o Augmentation", followed by an increase to 64.06 for "w/o Attention". The blue "Recall" line begins at 65.78 for "Full model (Ours)" and ends at 56.82 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation", with a decrease to 59.64 for "w/o Prompt", a peak at 62.63 for "w/o Augmentation", and a decline to 59.17 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The brown "F1-score" line starts at 65.49 for "Full model (Ours)" and ends at 57.74 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation", with a decrease to 60.16 for "w/o Prompt", a peak at 62.22 for "w/o Augmentation", and a decline to 59.67 for "w/o Attention".
